---
title: "Reading List"
description: "An evolving reading list spanning school attendance, psychology, behavioural addiction, digital health, measurement, and education."
page-layout: full
engine: markdown
---

```{=html}
<div class="page-header"><h1>Reading List</h1></div>
<p class="reading-intro">An evolving collection of papers shaping how I think — across school attendance and emotionally based school avoidance, but also psychology, behavioural addiction, digital health, measurement, and education systems.</p>
<div class="reading-toolbar" role="search" aria-label="Filter reading list">
  <div class="reading-toolbar-row">
    <div class="reading-search-wrap">
      <label for="reading-search" class="sr-only">Search reading list</label>
      <input id="reading-search" type="search" placeholder="Search titles, authors, notes…" autocomplete="off">
    </div>
    <div class="reading-multi">
      <button id="reading-themes-button" class="reading-multi-button" type="button" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false">All themes</button>
      <div id="reading-themes-menu" class="reading-multi-menu" hidden></div>
    </div>
    <div class="reading-multi">
      <button id="reading-topics-button" class="reading-multi-button" type="button" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false">All topics</button>
      <div id="reading-topics-menu" class="reading-multi-menu" hidden></div>
    </div>
    <div class="reading-multi">
      <button id="reading-types-button" class="reading-multi-button" type="button" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false">All study types</button>
      <div id="reading-types-menu" class="reading-multi-menu" hidden></div>
    </div>
    <div class="reading-control reading-year-range" role="group" aria-label="Year range">Years
      <label class="sr-only" for="reading-year-from">From year</label>
      <select id="reading-year-from"></select>
      <span aria-hidden="true">–</span>
      <label class="sr-only" for="reading-year-to">To year</label>
      <select id="reading-year-to"></select>
    </div>
    <label class="reading-control">Sort
      <select id="reading-sort">
        <option value="year-desc">Year (newest)</option>
        <option value="year-asc">Year (oldest)</option>
        <option value="title-asc">Title (A–Z)</option>
        <option value="author-asc">Author (A–Z)</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label class="reading-control">Per page
      <select id="reading-size">
        <option value="10">10</option><option value="20" selected>20</option>
        <option value="50">50</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <button id="reading-clear" class="reading-toolbar-button" type="button" hidden>Clear all</button>
  </div>
  <div id="reading-chips" class="reading-chips" aria-label="Active filters"></div>
  <div class="reading-selection-bar">
    <span id="reading-selection-summary">0 selected</span>
    <span class="reading-selection-actions">
      <button id="reading-select-shown" class="reading-toolbar-button" type="button">Select all shown</button>
      <button id="reading-clear-selection" class="reading-toolbar-button" type="button">Clear selection</button>
      <button id="reading-export-ris" class="reading-toolbar-button" type="button" disabled>Export RIS</button>
      <button id="reading-export-text" class="reading-toolbar-button" type="button" disabled>Export text</button>
    </span>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="reading-page-content">
{{< include /_includes/reading-entries.html >}}
<p id="reading-status" class="reading-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
<p id="reading-no-results" class="reading-status" hidden>No entries match your filters.</p>
<nav id="reading-pagination" class="reading-pagination" aria-label="Reading list pages"></nav>
<p id="reading-copy-status" class="sr-only" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
<script>
(function () {
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const status = $('reading-status');
  const content = $('reading-page-content');
  const toolbar = document.querySelector('.reading-toolbar');
  const search = $('reading-search');
  const yearFrom = $('reading-year-from');
  const yearTo = $('reading-year-to');
  const sort = $('reading-sort');
  const size = $('reading-size');
  const clear = $('reading-clear');
  const chips = $('reading-chips');
  const pagination = $('reading-pagination');
  const noResults = $('reading-no-results');
  const selectionSummary = $('reading-selection-summary');
  const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.reading-entry')).map(el => {
    let data = {};
    try { data = JSON.parse(el.dataset.meta || '{}'); } catch (_) {}
    return { el, data };
  });
  const byEl = new Map(items.map(item => [item.el, item]));
  const selected = new Set();
  const defaults = () => ({ q: '', themes: [], topics: [], types: [], yearFrom: '', yearTo: '', sort: 'year-desc', size: 20, page: 1 });
  let state = defaults();

  // ── Theme, topic and study-type dropdowns ──────────────────
  const THEME_ORDER = ['School attendance', 'Loneliness & connection', 'AI & technology', 'Mental health'];
  const multis = {
    themes: { label: 'themes', chip: 'Theme', all: 'All themes', values: item => item.data.themes || [], order: THEME_ORDER },
    topics: { label: 'topics', chip: 'Topic', all: 'All topics', values: item => item.data.tags || [] },
    types: { label: 'study types', chip: 'Study type', all: 'All study types', values: item => item.data.studyType ? [item.data.studyType] : [] },
  };
  Object.entries(multis).forEach(([type, multi]) => {
    multi.button = $(`reading-${type}-button`);
    multi.menu = $(`reading-${type}-menu`);
    multi.options = new Map();
    const counts = new Map();
    items.forEach(item => multi.values(item).forEach(v => counts.set(v, (counts.get(v) || 0) + 1)));
    const rank = v => (multi.order || []).indexOf(v);
    [...counts.keys()].sort((a, b) => (rank(a) - rank(b)) || a.localeCompare(b)).forEach(value => {
      const label = document.createElement('label');
      const checkbox = document.createElement('input');
      checkbox.type = 'checkbox';
      checkbox.value = value;
      checkbox.addEventListener('change', () => {
        setState({ [type]: [...multi.menu.querySelectorAll('input:checked')].map(input => input.value) });
      });
      const count = document.createElement('span');
      count.className = 'reading-multi-count';
      count.textContent = counts.get(value);
      label.append(checkbox, document.createTextNode(value), count);
      multi.menu.appendChild(label);
      multi.options.set(value, { label, checkbox, count });
    });
    multi.empty = document.createElement('p');
    multi.empty.className = 'reading-multi-empty';
    multi.empty.textContent = 'Nothing matches your other filters.';
    multi.empty.hidden = true;
    multi.menu.appendChild(multi.empty);
    multi.button.onclick = () => {
      const opening = multi.menu.hidden;
      closeMenus();
      if (opening) {
        multi.menu.hidden = false;
        multi.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    };
  });
  function closeMenus() {
    Object.values(multis).forEach(multi => {
      multi.menu.hidden = true;
      multi.button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
  }
  function syncCheckboxes() {
    Object.entries(multis).forEach(([type, multi]) => {
      multi.menu.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(input => { input.checked = state[type].includes(input.value); });
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (!event.target.closest('.reading-multi')) closeMenus();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') closeMenus();
  });

  // ── Year range ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  const years = [...new Set(items.map(item => Number(item.data.year)).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  function fillYears(select, anyLabel, list) {
    select.innerHTML = '';
    select.add(new Option(anyLabel, ''));
    list.forEach(y => select.add(new Option(String(y), String(y))));
  }
  fillYears(yearFrom, 'Earliest', years);
  fillYears(yearTo, 'Latest', [...years].reverse());
  yearFrom.onchange = () => setState({ yearFrom: yearFrom.value });
  yearTo.onchange = () => setState({ yearTo: yearTo.value });

  // ── Filtering and rendering ────────────────────────────────
  // Does a paper pass every filter? `skip` leaves one filter out, which is
  // how each menu works out what is still available given the others.
  function matches(item, skip) {
    const query = state.q.toLowerCase();
    if (query && !(item.el.dataset.search || '').includes(query)) return false;
    for (const [type, multi] of Object.entries(multis)) {
      if (type === skip || !state[type].length) continue;
      const values = multi.values(item);
      if (!state[type].some(v => values.includes(v))) return false;
    }
    if (skip !== 'years' && (state.yearFrom || state.yearTo)) {
      let lo = Number(state.yearFrom) || -Infinity;
      let hi = Number(state.yearTo) || Infinity;
      if (lo > hi) [lo, hi] = [hi, lo];
      const year = Number(item.data.year);
      if (!(year >= lo && year <= hi)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  // Each menu only offers options that would still return papers, with
  // counts that reflect the other filters. Ticked options always stay.
  function updateFacets() {
    Object.entries(multis).forEach(([type, multi]) => {
      const counts = new Map();
      items.filter(item => matches(item, type))
        .forEach(item => multi.values(item).forEach(v => counts.set(v, (counts.get(v) || 0) + 1)));
      let shown = 0;
      multi.options.forEach((option, value) => {
        const n = counts.get(value) || 0;
        option.count.textContent = n;
        option.label.hidden = n === 0 && !state[type].includes(value);
        if (!option.label.hidden) shown++;
      });
      multi.empty.hidden = shown > 0;
    });
    const yearCounts = new Map();
    items.filter(item => matches(item, 'years'))
      .forEach(item => yearCounts.set(String(item.data.year), (yearCounts.get(String(item.data.year)) || 0) + 1));
    [yearFrom, yearTo].forEach(select => {
      [...select.options].forEach(option => {
        if (!option.value) return;
        option.disabled = !yearCounts.get(option.value) && option.value !== select.value;
      });
    });
  }

  function filtered() {
    const result = items.filter(item => matches(item));
    result.sort((a, b) => {
      if (state.sort === 'title-asc') return (a.data.sortTitle || '').localeCompare(b.data.sortTitle || '');
      if (state.sort === 'author-asc') return (a.data.sortAuthor || '').localeCompare(b.data.sortAuthor || '');
      if (state.sort === 'year-asc') return (Number(a.data.sortYear) || 0) - (Number(b.data.sortYear) || 0);
      return (Number(b.data.sortYear) || 0) - (Number(a.data.sortYear) || 0);
    });
    return result;
  }

  function addChip(label, onRemove) {
    const chip = document.createElement('button');
    chip.type = 'button';
    chip.className = 'reading-chip';
    chip.textContent = `${label} ×`;
    chip.setAttribute('aria-label', `Remove filter: ${label}`);
    chip.onclick = onRemove;
    chips.appendChild(chip);
  }

  function renderChips() {
    chips.innerHTML = '';
    if (state.q) addChip(`Search: ${state.q}`, () => { search.value = ''; setState({ q: '' }); });
    Object.entries(multis).forEach(([type, multi]) => {
      state[type].forEach(value => addChip(`${multi.chip}: ${value}`, () => {
        setState({ [type]: state[type].filter(v => v !== value) });
      }));
      multi.button.textContent = state[type].length
        ? `${multi.label[0].toUpperCase()}${multi.label.slice(1)} (${state[type].length})`
        : multi.all;
    });
    if (state.yearFrom || state.yearTo) {
      addChip(`Years: ${state.yearFrom || 'earliest'}–${state.yearTo || 'latest'}`, () => {
        yearFrom.value = '';
        yearTo.value = '';
        setState({ yearFrom: '', yearTo: '' });
      });
    }
    clear.hidden = !chips.children.length;
  }

  function renderPagination(totalPages) {
    pagination.innerHTML = '';
    const add = (label, page, disabled, current) => {
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.type = 'button';
      button.textContent = label;
      button.disabled = disabled;
      if (current) button.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
      button.onclick = () => {
        state.page = page;
        render();
        status.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' });
      };
      pagination.appendChild(button);
    };
    add('Previous', state.page - 1, state.page === 1, false);
    for (let page = 1; page <= totalPages; page++) add(String(page), page, false, page === state.page);
    add('Next', state.page + 1, state.page === totalPages, false);
  }

  function setState(changes) {
    state = { ...state, ...changes, page: 1 };
    render();
  }

  function render() {
    const result = filtered();
    const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(result.length / state.size));
    state.page = Math.min(state.page, totalPages);
    const start = (state.page - 1) * state.size;
    const visible = new Set(result.slice(start, start + state.size).map(item => item.el));
    items.forEach(item => {
      item.el.style.display = visible.has(item.el) ? '' : 'none';
      const checkbox = item.el.querySelector('.reading-select');
      if (checkbox) checkbox.checked = selected.has(item.data.id);
      item.el.querySelectorAll('.reading-tag').forEach(tag => {
        tag.classList.toggle('is-active', state[tag.dataset.filterType].includes(tag.dataset.filterValue));
      });
    });
    noResults.hidden = result.length !== 0;
    syncCheckboxes();
    updateFacets();
    renderChips();
    renderPagination(totalPages);
    selectionSummary.textContent = `${selected.size} selected`;
    $('reading-export-ris').disabled = selected.size === 0;
    $('reading-export-text').disabled = selected.size === 0;
    status.textContent = `${result.length} ${result.length === 1 ? 'entry' : 'entries'} found, page ${state.page} of ${totalPages}.`;
  }

  search.oninput = () => setState({ q: search.value.trim() });
  sort.onchange = () => { state.sort = sort.value; state.page = 1; render(); };
  size.onchange = () => { state.size = Number(size.value); state.page = 1; render(); };
  clear.onclick = () => {
    search.value = '';
    yearFrom.value = '';
    yearTo.value = '';
    sort.value = 'year-desc';
    size.value = '20';
    state = defaults();
    render();
  };

  // ── Clicking a tag on an entry filters by it ───────────────
  content.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const tag = event.target.closest('.reading-tag');
    if (!tag) return;
    const type = tag.dataset.filterType;
    const value = tag.dataset.filterValue;
    const active = state[type].includes(value);
    setState({ [type]: active ? state[type].filter(v => v !== value) : [...state[type], value] });
    if (!active) toolbar.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  });

  // ── Copy APA ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Asks doi.org for the official APA 7 reference (full author list, journal,
  // volume). Falls back to one built from the saved fields if that fails.
  const apaCache = new Map();
  function localApa(d) {
    let authors = (d.authors || '').trim();
    const parts = authors.split(/,\s*(?=[^,]+,\s*[A-Z]\.)/);
    if (parts.length > 1 && !/et al\.?$/.test(authors)) {
      authors = parts.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ', & ' + parts[parts.length - 1];
    }
    const title = (d.title || '').replace(/\.*$/, '');
    return [
      authors ? `${authors.replace(/\.*$/, '')}.` : '',
      `(${d.year || 'n.d.'}).`,
      `${title}.`,
      d.journal ? `${d.journal}.` : '',
      d.doi ? `https://doi.org/${d.doi}` : ''
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
  }
  async function getApa(d) {
    if (apaCache.has(d.id)) return apaCache.get(d.id);
    let apa = '';
    if (d.doi) {
      try {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 6000);
        const res = await fetch(`https://doi.org/${encodeURI(d.doi)}`, {
          headers: { Accept: 'text/x-bibliography; style=apa' },
          signal: controller.signal
        });
        clearTimeout(timer);
        if (res.ok) apa = (await res.text()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    if (!apa || apa.startsWith('<')) apa = localApa(d);
    apaCache.set(d.id, apa);
    return apa;
  }
  async function copyText(text) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      return true;
    } catch (_) {
      const area = document.createElement('textarea');
      area.value = text;
      area.setAttribute('readonly', '');
      area.style.position = 'fixed';
      area.style.opacity = '0';
      document.body.appendChild(area);
      area.select();
      const ok = document.execCommand('copy');
      area.remove();
      return ok;
    }
  }
  content.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('.reading-copy-apa');
    if (!button || button.disabled) return;
    const item = byEl.get(button.closest('.reading-entry'));
    if (!item) return;
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Copying…';
    const apa = await getApa(item.data);
    const ok = await copyText(apa);
    button.textContent = ok ? 'Copied ✓' : 'Copy failed';
    button.title = apa;
    $('reading-copy-status').textContent = ok ? 'APA reference copied.' : 'Could not copy the reference.';
    setTimeout(() => { button.textContent = 'Copy APA'; button.disabled = false; }, 2000);
  });

  // ── Selection and export ───────────────────────────────────
  $('reading-select-shown').onclick = () => {
    filtered().slice((state.page - 1) * state.size, state.page * state.size)
      .forEach(item => selected.add(item.data.id));
    render();
  };
  $('reading-clear-selection').onclick = () => {
    selected.clear();
    render();
  };
  items.forEach(item => {
    const checkbox = item.el.querySelector('.reading-select');
    if (checkbox) checkbox.onchange = () => {
      if (checkbox.checked) selected.add(item.data.id); else selected.delete(item.data.id);
      render();
    };
  });
  function exportSelected(format) {
    const selectedItems = items.filter(item => selected.has(item.data.id)).map(item => item.data);
    const content = format === 'ris'
      ? selectedItems.map(d => [
          'TY  - JOUR',
          d.authors ? `AU  - ${d.authors}` : '',
          d.title ? `TI  - ${d.title}` : '',
          d.journal ? `JO  - ${d.journal}` : '',
          d.year ? `PY  - ${d.year}` : '',
          d.doi ? `DO  - ${d.doi}\nUR  - https://doi.org/${d.doi}` : '',
          d.abstract ? `AB  - ${d.abstract}` : '',
          'ER  - '
        ].filter(Boolean).join('\r\n')).join('\r\n')
      : selectedItems.map(d =>
          `${d.title}\n${d.authors}${d.year ? ` (${d.year})` : ''}${d.journal ? `\n${d.journal}` : ''}${d.doi ? `\nhttps://doi.org/${d.doi}` : ''}`
        ).join('\n\n');
    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: format === 'ris' ? 'application/x-research-info-systems' : 'text/plain' });
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = `reading-list-selected.${format === 'ris' ? 'ris' : 'txt'}`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href);
  }
  $('reading-export-ris').onclick = () => exportSelected('ris');
  $('reading-export-text').onclick = () => exportSelected('text');
  render();
})();
</script>
</div>
```
